name: Split-flap board
what: A departures board: every tile flips through letters until it lands on its own, left to right and row after row, so the words settle like a wave.

learned_from.what: the board, rows of letters flipping until they land, the title bar

motion: a letter every 2 f with a falling flap, landing 2 f apart along a row, 5 f between rows
